breaking_news.headline: Broadcom beats Q3 but Q4 revenue guide narrowly misses
breaking_news.summary: Broadcom reported Q3 revenue about $29.59B and adjusted EPS $3.32, both above consensus. Q4 revenue guide was about $34.8B versus roughly $35.03B expected, while Q4 AI chip sales were guided to about $21.7B.
breaking_news.market_impact: AI custom-silicon demand remains powerful, but valuation sensitivity is high because expectations are extreme.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Mixed-positive for Taiwan ASIC, advanced packaging, substrates, PCB, networking and power supply chains; near-term sentiment may be capped by the slight top-line guide miss.

breaking_news.headline: Snowflake raises annual product-revenue forecast on AI demand
breaking_news.summary: Snowflake raised FY2027 product revenue guidance to $6.07B from $5.84B after Q2 product revenue rose 37% to $1.49B; adjusted EPS was $0.62 versus $0.45 expected.
breaking_news.market_impact: Confirms enterprise AI spending is broadening beyond hardware into cloud data platforms and software.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Indirect positive for hyperscaler/cloud infrastructure demand and data-center buildout.

breaking_news.headline: HPE lifts annual outlook as AI and networking demand accelerates
breaking_news.summary: HPE Q3 revenue rose 33.6% to $12.21B and adjusted EPS reached $1.11. FY2026 revenue growth guidance was raised to 34%-37% and adjusted EPS to $3.75-$3.85.
breaking_news.market_impact: Another strong confirmation that AI server and networking demand remain robust even as supply constraints persist.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Constructive for ODM, server, networking, memory, storage, PCB, cooling and power suppliers.

breaking_news.headline: Wall Street rebounds as oil and yields stabilize
breaking_news.summary: Dow +0.56%, S&P 500 +0.46%, Nasdaq +0.45%; Russell 2000 outperformed by about 1.1%. Nvidia rose 3.2%.
breaking_news.market_impact: Risk appetite improved, but bond yields and Iran-related energy risk remain the key macro overhangs.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Supports a tactical rebound in AI/semiconductor shares, but high U.S. yields still argue for selective exposure.

breaking_news.headline: WTI settles at $91.01 as U.S.-Iran strikes threaten supplies
breaking_news.summary: WTI rose $0.79 to $91.01 and Brent rose $0.98 to $95.63 as the conflict continued to threaten Strait of Hormuz flows.
breaking_news.market_impact: Keeps inflation risk elevated and limits how far long-bond yields can fall.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Headwind for high-duration growth and energy-intensive industries; potential support for energy/shipping themes.

breaking_news.headline: ADP private payroll growth disappoints
breaking_news.summary: Reuters reported August private payroll additions were below expectations, reinforcing focus on Friday's official employment report.
breaking_news.market_impact: Soft labor data offsets some inflation pressure from oil, but the Fed path remains hostage to Friday payrolls.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: A softer U.S. labor print can ease yield pressure on growth stocks if oil does not reaccelerate.

narration_points: 美股在連跌後反彈，但不是全面解除風險：10年債仍接近4.8%，WTI仍站上91美元。
小型股與NVIDIA領漲，顯示風險偏好回溫；但SOX只小漲，半導體仍處於高波動輪動。
Broadcom財報證明AI客製晶片需求強，但Q4總營收指引略低預期，AI交易進入高標準驗證期。
Snowflake與HPE同步上調展望，說明AI支出正從GPU/伺服器向資料平台、網路與企業基礎設施擴散。
台灣供應鏈中期基本面仍受惠，但高利率與能源通膨使追價風險上升。
今晚先看美國服務業、貿易與生產力，最後由週五非農決定利率與AI估值方向。
